rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for someone who is generally inattentive or careless.

example.english: They are careless at work and often miss important details.
example.traditional: 佢做嘢一向都大意，成日漏咗啲重要細節。
example.jyutping: keoi5 zou6 je5 jat1 hoeng3 dou1 daai6 ji3 seng4 jat6 lau6 zo2 di1 zung6 jiu3 sai3 zit3

rows.note: Use this when the carelessness concerns a particular action, mistake, or failure to take care.

example.english: I was careless and knocked over the glass of water just now.
example.traditional: 我頭先唔小心整跌咗杯水。
example.jyutping: ngo5 tau4 sin1 m4 siu2 sam1 zing2 dit3 zo2 bui1 seoi2

rows.note: Use this when careless means not worried or unconcerned about something.

example.english: They are careless about their own safety and are not worried at all.
example.traditional: 佢對自己嘅安全完全唔擔心。
example.jyutping: keoi5 deoi3 zi6 gei2 ge3 on1 cyun4 jyun4 cyun4 m4 daam1 sam1

rows.note: Use this when the person shows indifference or does not care about the matter rather than merely lacking worry.

example.english: They are careless about other people's feelings and simply do not care.
example.traditional: 佢對人哋嘅感受完全唔在乎。
example.jyutping: keoi5 deoi3 jan4 dei6 ge3 gam2 sau6 jyun4 cyun4 m4 zoi6 fu4
